guarantees.claim: we_q is updated with we_d on every positive edge of clk_i when rst_ni is high.
armed_q is updated with armed_d on every positive edge of clk_i when rst_ni is high.
we_q is cleared to all zeros ('0) when rst_ni is low (asynchronous reset).
armed_q is cleared to 1'b0 when rst_ni is low (asynchronous reset).

assumptions.claim: we_d must be stable and valid at the rising edge of clk_i to be correctly captured into we_q.
assumptions.risk: If we_d contains glitches or invalid values at the sampling edge, we_q may capture them, potentially causing unintended write-enable assertion in downstream logic.

assumptions.claim: armed_d must be stable and valid at the rising edge of clk_i to be correctly captured into armed_q.
assumptions.risk: If armed_d contains glitches or invalid values at the sampling edge, armed_q may capture them, potentially causing incorrect arming state in downstream security logic.
